src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.name: Activity log lookup outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.description: Describes how the activity log of who did what is read back, without saying how the database does it.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.name: Activity log entry
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.description: One line of the activity log: when it happened, who did it, what was done, to what, any reason given, and the connected app involved if any.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.name: Record history summary
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.description: Works out, from the activity log, who first created a record and who last changed it. It is never stored separately.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.name: Spending per category
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.description: The total spent in one expense category over a period.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.name: Expense summary
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.description: The expense report: total per category, the grand total and the currency.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.name: Export table
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.description: One table of data for a backup download: column headings plus rows that are read one at a time so large exports do not fill memory.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.name: Per-flock production row
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.description: One flock's line in the production report's breakdown for the chosen period.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.name: Eggs per grade
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.description: How many eggs there were in one egg grade.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.name: Reports and activity log outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.description: Lists what the reporting area offers: production, sales, expense and profit reports, data exports, the activity log and record history.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.name: Production day
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.description: One day's egg production, including the hand-graded sellable eggs left after cracked, dirty and discarded ones are taken out.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.name: Production report
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.description: The egg production report for a period: daily figures, totals per grade and flock, and the figures behind the period's laying rate so it can be checked.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.name: Profit report
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.description: A basic profit figure: confirmed sales minus recorded expenses, shown with both numbers and feed cost, including feed cost per dozen eggs. It does not value stock.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.name: Sales summary
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.description: Sales for a period: confirmed and voided orders, revenue, amount paid, amount still owed, and eggs sold overall and by grade.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.name: Data export outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.description: Describes how the farm's data is fetched, table by table, for manual backup downloads.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.name: Report lookup outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Insigh.description: Describes the read-only report questions: production, sales, expenses and profit for a date range.
